metadata.question: Did Sierra Estrella show higher land surface temperature than PHX Airport in July 19, 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need land surface temperature (LST) data for July 19, 2023 - Best source: MODIS LST products (MOD11A1 or MYD11A1) or Landsat 8/9 thermal bands - Two locations: Sierra Estrella (mountain range southwest of Phoenix) and Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport - Use MODIS Terra LST (MOD11A1) for daily data at 1km resolution 2. Masking strategy: - MODIS LST has QA bands to filter poor quality pixels - Mask clouds and low-quality observations - This is about actual LST, not clouds 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - LST values should be in reasonable range (typically 250-350 K or -23 to 77°C) - Check pixel counts after masking - Compare: if both locations have valid data, answer A (Sierra Estrella > Airport) or B (Airport >= Sierra Estrella) - If no images or no valid pixels after masking, answer C1 or C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN or unreasonable values, answer C3 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions # Sierra Estrella - mountain range southwest of Phoenix sierra_estrella = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.4, 33.3]) # Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport phx_airport = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.0074, 33.4342]) date_start = '2023-07-19' date_end = '2023-07-20' # 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra LST col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \ .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \ .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']) print(f"Total images found: {col.size().getInfo()}") if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print("No MODIS data for July 19, 2023.") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Get the image and apply QA masking img = col.first() # Mask using QA - keep only good quality pixels (bits 0-1 = 00) qa = img.select('QC_Day') lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km') # QA bits 0-1: 00 = good, 01 = other quality qa_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0) lst_masked = lst.updateMask(qa_mask).multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15) # Convert to Celsius # 4. Calculate LST for both locations # Sierra Estrella sierra_stats = lst_masked.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=sierra_estrella.buffer(1000), scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ) sierra_lst = sierra_stats.get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() sierra_count = lst_masked.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=sierra_estrella.buffer(1000), scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() # Phoenix Airport airport_stats = lst_masked.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=phx_airport.buffer(1000), scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ) airport_lst = airport_stats.get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() airport_count = lst_masked.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=phx_airport.buffer(1000), scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo() # 5. Validation & Final Answer print(f"Sierra Estrella: LST={sierra_lst}°C, Pixels={sierra_count}") print(f"PHX Airport: LST={airport_lst}°C, Pixels={airport_count}") if sierra_count == 0 or airport_count == 0: print("No valid pixels after masking.") print("C2") elif sierra_lst is None or airport_lst is None: print("Calculation failed - returned None.") print("C3") elif sierra_lst < -50 or sierra_lst > 80 or airport_lst < -50 or airport_lst > 80: print("Invalid temperature range.") print("C3") elif sierra_lst > airport_lst: print("Sierra Estrella showed higher LST than PHX Airport.") print("A") else: print("PHX Airport LST >= Sierra Estrella LST.") print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Sierra Estrella - mountain range southwest of Phoenix
sierra_estrella = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.4, 33.3])
# Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport
phx_airport = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.0074, 33.4342])

date_start = '2023-07-19'
date_end = '2023-07-20'

# 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Terra LST
col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day'])

print(f"Total images found: {col.size().getInfo()}")

if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No MODIS data for July 19, 2023.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Get the image and apply QA masking
    img = col.first()
    
    # Mask using QA - keep only good quality pixels (bits 0-1 = 00)
    qa = img.select('QC_Day')
    lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km')
    
    # QA bits 0-1: 00 = good, 01 = other quality
    qa_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0)
    lst_masked = lst.updateMask(qa_mask).multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)  # Convert to Celsius
    
    # 4. Calculate LST for both locations
    # Sierra Estrella
    sierra_stats = lst_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=sierra_estrella.buffer(1000),
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    sierra_lst = sierra_stats.get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    
    sierra_count = lst_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=sierra_estrella.buffer(1000),
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    
    # Phoenix Airport
    airport_stats = lst_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=phx_airport.buffer(1000),
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    airport_lst = airport_stats.get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    
    airport_count = lst_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=phx_airport.buffer(1000),
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    print(f"Sierra Estrella: LST={sierra_lst}°C, Pixels={sierra_count}")
    print(f"PHX Airport: LST={airport_lst}°C, Pixels={airport_count}")
    
    if sierra_count == 0 or airport_count == 0:
        print("No valid pixels after masking.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    elif sierra_lst is None or airport_lst is None:
        print("Calculation failed - returned None.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif sierra_lst < -50 or sierra_lst > 80 or airport_lst < -50 or airport_lst > 80:
        print("Invalid temperature range.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif sierra_lst > airport_lst:
        print("Sierra Estrella showed higher LST than PHX Airport.")
        print("<answer>A</answer>")
    else:
        print("PHX Airport LST >= Sierra Estrella LST.")
        print("<answer>B</answer>")

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Sierra Estrella - mountain range southwest of Phoenix
sierra_estrella = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.4, 33.3])
# Phoenix Sky Harbor Airport
phx_airport = ee.Geometry.Point([-112.0074, 33.4342])

date_start = '2023-07-19'
date_end = '2023-07-20'

# 2. Try MODIS first with relaxed QA
modis_col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day'])

print(f"MODIS images found: {modis_col.size().getInfo()}")

if modis_col.size().getInfo() > 0:
    img = modis_col.first()
    qa = img.select('QC_Day')
    lst = img.select('LST_Day_1km')
    
    # Relaxed QA: accept good (00) and other quality (01) - mask only 10 and 11
    qa_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1)
    lst_masked = lst.updateMask(qa_mask).multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15)
    
    sierra_count = lst_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=sierra_estrella.buffer(1000),
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    
    airport_count = lst_masked.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=phx_airport.buffer(1000),
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
    
    print(f"MODIS pixels (relaxed QA) - Sierra: {sierra_count}, Airport: {airport_count}")
    
    if sierra_count > 0 and airport_count > 0:
        sierra_lst = lst_masked.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=sierra_estrella.buffer(1000),
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
        
        airport_lst = lst_masked.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=phx_airport.buffer(1000),
            scale=1000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo()
        
        print(f"Sierra Estrella: {sierra_lst:.2f}°C")
        print(f"PHX Airport: {airport_lst:.2f}°C")
        
        if sierra_lst is None or airport_lst is None:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif sierra_lst < -50 or sierra_lst > 80 or airport_lst < -50 or airport_lst > 80:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        elif sierra_lst > airport_lst:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
    else:
        # Try Landsat 9
        print("MODIS failed, trying Landsat 9...")
        l9_col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') \
            .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
            .filterBounds(sierra_estrella)
        
        print(f"Landsat 9 images: {l9_col.size().getInfo()}")
        
        if l9_col.size().getInfo() > 0:
            l9_img = l9_col.first()
            lst_band = l9_img.select('ST_B10').multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0).subtract(273.15)
            
            sierra_lst = lst_band.reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                geometry=sierra_estrella.buffer(1000),
                scale=1000,
                maxPixels=1e9
            ).get('ST_B10').getInfo()
            
            airport_lst = lst_band.reduceRegion(
                reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                geometry=phx_airport.buffer(1000),
                scale=1000,
                maxPixels=1e9
            ).get('ST_B10').getInfo()
            
            print(f"Sierra: {sierra_lst:.2f}°C, Airport: {airport_lst:.2f}°C")
            
            if sierra_lst is None or airport_lst is None:
                print("<answer>C3</answer>")
            elif sierra_lst > airport_lst:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
